desc: Parse input, store houses with IDs, and compute final position using Python integers to avoid overflow.
Build dictionaries mapping each `y` to sorted `(x, house_id)` lists and each `x` to sorted `(y, house_id)` lists.
Convert each move into an inclusive axis-aligned segment and apply range additions on the corresponding line's difference array over sorted house coordinates.
Prefix-sum each line's difference arrays to mark house IDs covered horizontally and vertically.
Count distinct house IDs marked by either orientation and print final `X`, `Y`, and count.
If difference-array implementation has issues, fall back to offline interval union per line with merged intervals and per-house membership checks.
